speaker: both
text: Morty: Holy cow, Rick! I didn't know hanging out with you is making me smarter! — Rick: Full disclosure, Morty, it's not.

speaker: morty
text: Oh, man! Oh, oh, oh, jeez!

speaker: rick
text: If you stick with me, I'm gonna accomplish great things, Morty… Rick and Morty forever and forever, a hundred years.

speaker: rick
text: Listen, Morty, what people call love is just a chemical reaction… Break the cycle, Morty. Rise above. Focus on science.

speaker: morty
text: Oh my god!

speaker: rick
text: Listen to your sister, Morty. To live is to risk it all. Otherwise you're just an inert chunk of randomly assembled molecules drifting wherever the universe blows you.

speaker: rick
text: I'll tell you how I feel about school, Jerry. It's a waste of time… It's not a place for smart people.

speaker: rick
text: If you'll excuse me, I've got pancakes back home with syrup on top of them… So as they say in Canada, peace oot.

speaker: rick
text: Every hospital claims to have the best doctor in the galaxy. It's like those pizza places… Have you ever been to a pizza contest?

speaker: rick
text: Uncertainty is inherently unsustainable. Eventually, everything either is or isn't.

speaker: morty
text: This is insane.

speaker: morty
text: Rick, what about the reality we left behind?

speaker: rick
text: Listen, I'm not the nicest guy in the universe, because I'm the smartest. Being nice is something stupid people do to hedge their bets.

speaker: rick
text: I couldn't make marriage work, and I could turn a black hole into a sun… what are the odds this is legit?

speaker: morty
text: Oh, boy.

speaker: rick
text: Did you just try to call my bluff? Have you ever seen me bluff? I'm not a cow. I'm a pickle when I feel like it.

speaker: both
text: Morty: I don't like how meta this is getting, Rick. — Rick: Shut up, Morty. You're 14. You watch videos of people on YouTube reacting to fucking YouTube.

speaker: rick
text: Oh god, it hurts. She got me right in the goddamn liver, Morty. It's the hardest working liver in the galaxy, and now it has a hole in it.

speaker: rick
text: You're both young, you're both unsure about your place in the universe… as far as grandpa's concerned, you're both pieces of shit. I can prove it mathematically.

speaker: rick
text: Pack your shit. You fuck with squirrels, Morty. We got five minutes before they're on our ass. We're fucked over here because of these damn squirrels.

speaker: both
text: Rick: Oh, that's great logic, Morty. You probably spilled this shit everywhere… — Morty: I did not spill it. — Rick: Which is why I have sidekick rules.

speaker: morty
text: Oh, man!

speaker: morty
text: Yeah, yeah, so you keep telling me.

speaker: morty
text: I was just trying to do right!
